describe.description: The creature is a large standing bird shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background. The upper body is that of a brown eagle with a feathered head, hooked beak, folded wings, and feathered legs ending in scaly yellow feet with black talons. The lower legs and rear are modified with octopus-like features: circular sucker discs are visible on the skin of the thighs and shanks, and in place of a feathered tail a cluster of thick, muscular tentacles hangs down from the rear, each lined with rows of pale suckers and curling at the tips. The overall color is brown and golden-brown plumage with yellow on the beak base and feet and dark gray on the beak tip and talons.

describe.description: A large standing bird with the head, beak, feathered body, folded wings, feathered legs and taloned feet of a brown eagle, shown in right-facing profile. The rear underside where a tail would be instead bears a cluster of long tapering brown tentacles lined with pale suckers that hang down and curl at the tips. Patches of bare skin on the lower belly and upper legs also bear circular pale sucker-like spots.
